heroHeadline: SAF Shoots Down RSF Drone Over White Nile State; RSF Renews al-Murrah Assault Under Blackout — El-Obeid Residential Strike Kills Up to 24 Including 8 Children
heroSubtitle: On Day 1142, SAF air defenses intercepted a long-range RSF drone over White Nile State (May 31) and launched retaliatory drone strikes on RSF positions in North Kordofan — the first confirmed drone shoot-down over the region following a sustained RSF campaign that has struck hospitals, fuel depots, and military bases throughout spring 2026. RSF forces renewed their ground assault on al-Murrah villages west of Barah (May 30) under a complete communications blackout, one day after the Eid al-Adha massacre that killed at least 27 civilians in the same area. Separately, an RSF drone strike on a residential house in El-Obeid on May 29 killed 10–24 civilians including 8 children, according to multiple sources (Sudan Doctors Network: 13 killed; PBS: 24 killed; Dabanga: 10 killed). SAF's Kordofan counteroffensive continues — recent gains include the Dibebad crossroads (May 22–23), the third relief of Dilling (May 19–20), and the capture of Wadi al-Atrun (May 19) cutting an RSF trans-Saharan supply corridor. Chad's border closure from the May 25 Al-Tina market strike (14 killed) and the destruction of Misterei, West Darfur (May 28; 28–97 Masalit killed) remain in effect. With 14 million displaced, 19.5 million acutely food insecure, and the June–August lean season beginning, Sudan's humanitarian catastrophe deepens.
